protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: the vendor advisory identifies six attribute-view metadata interpolations whose output is assigned through innerHTML. The view.desc and colData.desc textarea bodies are raw despite escapeAttr on the adjacent data-value attribute, so </textarea> closes the element and attacker markup is parsed. The clone also confirms unvalidated description setters and Electron nodeIntegration:true/contextIsolation:false, making renderer script execution reach Node built-ins.

Later cce77eb712796f4deec631b62553f43aba1ac238 copies the same defect into getEditHTML and later commits add the group-name sinks; they are expansions, not an earlier BIC.
